name: Flywheel Dynamo Canyon
core_rationale: Eastern kinetic-storage gorge of Continent 02 where Krono's hundred-meter brass flywheels store surplus wind-torque from the steppe windmills.
local_conflict: Centrifugal spark-automatons and copper-armored Pangolins patrol the spinning flywheel rim-bridges.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Tinkers say the great flywheels of Flywheel Dynamo Canyon spin so smoothly that a coin balanced on the axle housing never tips over.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Colossal solid-brass flywheel discs spinning inside a terraced copper canyon.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What kinetic governor sanctuary sits between the twin flywheels of Flywheel Dynamo Canyon?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline along the eastern kinetic-storage gorge of Continent 02.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Colossal solid-brass flywheel discs storing wind-torque inside a terraced copper canyon.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: flywheel gantry and governor console metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: reserved as the ninth District frontier on Continent 02 with zero filler maps.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Provides complete mystery_hook (in_world_rumor, visual_silhouette, unanswered_question) and empty grid_nodes.
